title: Ultra-Garlicky Turkish Cheese Kisir
description: A date-night Turkish dish featuring a garlicky, molten mascarpone filling in a crispy ovo-vegetarian-friendly kisir form.
instructions: Shape the mascarpone cheese mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter.
Dip the balls into the beaten egg, then roll in the chopped parsley to coat.
Place the coated balls onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the cheese is baking, prepare the garlic-walnut sauce by blending the minced garlic and chopped walnuts in a food processor.
Add the Greek yogurt to the food processor and blend until smooth.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the baked cheese balls with the garlic-walnut sauce spooned over the top.
Optional: garnish with a sprig of basil.
